query: AMD data center segment revenue for the last four reported quarters
normalized: amd center data four quarters reported revenue segment

output.content:
AMD’s last four reported quarters of **Data Center segment net revenue** were: 

| Fiscal quarter | Quarter ended | Revenue |
|---|---:|---:|
| Q2 2026 | June 27, 2026 | **$6.718 billion** |
| Q1 2026 | March 28, 2026 | **$5.775 billion** |
| Q4 2025 | December 27, 2025 | **$5.380 billion** |
| Q3 2025 | September 27, 2025 | **$4.341 billion** | 

AMD reported $6.718 billion in Q2 2026 Data Center revenue, up 16% sequentially from $5.775 billion in Q1 2026. [[1]] 

AMD’s Q1 2026 filing identifies the Q1 Data Center figure as $5.775 billion. [[2]] 

AMD’s Q4 2025 results report $5.380 billion for Q4 and $4.341 billion for Q3 2025. [[3]] 

Across these four quarters, Data Center revenue increased by $2.377 billion, or approximately 55%, from Q3 2025 to Q2 2026. [[1]] [[3]]
